abstract: One of the factors determining the prognosis of choriocarcinoma is the stromal reaction of the host. We have been interested in the histologic findings of this reaction, and we studied the relationship between the CPV classification, which had been used in our department, and our clinical stage. There was no relation of stage distribution to CPV classification. For instance, Type C, which has a strong stromal reaction, did not display any parallel relation with stage. When mortality rates and stages are compared, however, it is noteworthy that the mortality rate for Type C cases is small in Stage I and is less than 50% even in Stage III, in which metastasis is considered to be inevitable; thus, more than half of the cases are cured. On the contrary, Types P and C tend to be associated with high mortality rates even in Stages I and II, in which metastasis is not certain.
abstract_ja: 宿主の間質反応は絨毛癌の予後を規定する因子の一つである。当科で用いてきたCPV分類と当科の臨床病期との関係を検討した。CPV分類と病期分布との間には関係がなかった。間質反応が強いC型は、病期Iでの死亡率は低く、転移が避けられないとされる病期IIIでも死亡率は50%未満で、半数以上の症例が治癒した。一方、P型とC型は病期Iや病期IIのように転移が確実でない段階でも死亡率が高い傾向があった。
